verdict.rationale: A runtime probe found a public OpenAPI 3.1 spec of about 405 paths at /openapi.json, with Swagger UI served at /docs. That is an interactive API reference, but it appears to be an exposed internal app/bridge API rather than a supported developer reference. No developer program or public API keys are documented, so running examples against it is unproven for an outside user. Missing for 10: documented public developer API program, API keys/auth onboarding so 'try it out' calls actually run, curated runnable examples, first-party docs presenting the reference to users, independent hands-on corroboration.
